topic: Next-Generation Simulation Tools for Real-Time Process Modeling
title: Next-Generation Simulation Tools for Real-Time Process Modeling
session_title: Next-Generation Simulation Tools for Real-Time Process Modeling
abstract: In this hands-on lab, you’ll explore the integration between AVEVA™ Process Simulation and the AVEVA™ PI System™. Learn how simulation models can unlock valuable insights from operational data by calculating real-time KPIs for both processes and equipment. We'll also discuss how online simulation can support sustainability efforts, improve maintenance strategies, and aid in process troubleshooting. No prior experience with process simulation is required - just a willingness to learn and expand your skillset! Be sure to register: https://engage.aveva.com/2025-aiche-workshop-registration.html
